newsitem.title: ITALY: Short-term Italy bond spreads to fall soon-Ciampi.
newsitem.headline: Short-term Italy bond spreads to fall soon-Ciampi.

text.p: The recent fall in long-term Italian bond spreads should soon be followed by a similar reduction in short-term spreads, Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said in a statement on Tuesday.
The spread between Italian 10-year fixed rate bonds and the benchmark bund narrowed to a record 98 basis points in early trading on Tuesday.
However the spread between Italian and German three year bonds stood at around 200 basis points on Tuesday while the three month spread stood at some 366 basis points.
"The strong reduction in the spread at the long end, which is the most important, must be followed by a reduction in the short-end spreads," Ciampi said.
Ciampi welcomed the fall in the 10-year spread.
"This is not a chance happening, nor is it just due to technical factors. It is an expression of faith in Italy that is taking root in the judgement and moves of the market," his statement said.

Tne 10-year spread has closed steadily in recent weeks as investors bet on Italy's increasing chances of joining European economic and monetary union (EMU) in the first wave. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
